review_questions: Independently review PR 21 exact candidate 16ae65c9d4939efc05aeff76f0ae2e708428b3b1. Assume false-green; do not trust proposer conclusions, CI labels, or prior PASS labels.

Evidence-bound rule: the materialized corpus contains the Slice9 contract, Slice9 mechanism source, real-Slice8 integration test, exact-head CI evidence, and history. It does NOT contain the full generic Slice9 acceptance-harness source or full Slice8 transport source. Do not claim to have reviewed absent files. A TESTED_SUPPORTED dimension must cite only material actually present; CI is execution evidence, not absent-source semantics.
Verify Slice9 is only a deterministic local credential-lease gate: no real secret manager/provider/GitHub/cloud credential or side effect, and no authority widening.

Verify exact accepted Slice8 completion integrity is checked before broker access, including result/completion/binding hashes, idempotency key, remote-result digest/status, exact lineage, and false production-side-effect markers. Verify from the materialized mechanism/contract: raw-secret rejection/non-persistence, profile policy intersection, use-time freshness/revocation/epoch checks, lease expiry/revocation, replay/rebind control, restart semantics, opaque-handle forgery denial, credential-not-authority, and provider-neutral data-driven behavior.

Verify preserved scientific history and exact-head CI. Search adversarially for remaining contract/evidence/hash/secret/replay/authority bypasses using only materialized evidence. If any mandatory dimension cannot be supported without an omitted file, mark it INSUFFICIENT or NOT_TESTED rather than inferring access.

required_review_dimensions.description: Local reference lease gate only; no real external credential/effect or authority widening.
Canonical Slice8 hashes, idempotency/result evidence and lineage validated before broker access.
Real accepted Slice8 output is exercised, not an invented schema.
Lease binding uses Slice8 completion-evidence binding_hash.
Tampered Slice8 result/completion/binding hashes fail before broker access.
Raw secrets are rejected and absent from governed records/evidence/diagnostics.
Lease scope cannot exceed terminal lineage or current profile policy.
Profile/lease freshness, epochs and revocations are enforced at use time.
Replay is non-amplifying; rebinding, stale refresh and forged handles fail closed.
Credential/handle possession cannot substitute for governed authority.
Recovery preserves bounded metadata without governed raw-secret persistence.
Future provider/profile handling remains data driven.
Red, false-green, defect-exposure, fixture-isolation and provider-capacity failures are preserved and correctly classified.
